posts.title: Law No. 4 of 2026 on Right of Litigation
posts.description: All legal provisions that bar the right to litigation, or that shield any act or administrative decision from the oversight of the competent judiciary, are repealed, wherever they appear in the legislation in force.

posts.title: Chart: Syria’s Top 10 Trade Partners in 2025
posts.description: Turkey was, by far, Syria's largest trade partner last year, with imports worth around USD 3.5 billion and exports worth USD 235 million.

posts.title: France’s Accor to Operate Movenpick Hotel as Work Resumes on the Long-Stalled Project
posts.description: Syrian companies Sankari Holding and Rotana Star Holding began construction work on the Movenpick Hotel and the Arab Mall in the Kafr Sousseh district of Damascus on November 17, reviving a project originally due for completion in 2010. The two investors signed an agreement with French hospitality group Accor to operate the 300-room hotel.
